words: 문항 유도를 줄이려면 질문과 선택지가 특정 답을 암시하는지 확인해요.

To reduce leading questions, I check whether the wording or answer options suggest a particular response.

Without an explanation of how missing responses were handled, it is hard to verify how the percentage was calculated.
가중치 부여 전후의 결과를 둘 다 보여요.
Ich zeige Ergebnisse vor und nach der Gewichtung.
I show results both before and after weighting.
Gruppen außerhalb des Auswahlrahmens nenne ich in der Fußnote.

Two people apply the open-code scheme independently.

If the collection window is right after an election, I soften the reading.

Publishing the design memo can help others reassess the survey results later.
